title: Ornaments

children.text: Sample text, to be replaced in the Studio. Small felt ornaments are shaped by needling and rolling wool into solid forms, so they are light, soft to hold and hard to break. Details such as eyes, scarves and saddles are worked in by hand, which means no two turn out exactly alike. Most hang from a twisted red and white loop. This introduction will describe the ornaments available, any seasonal ranges, and how shops can ask about buying assorted felt ornaments in quantity for retail or for gifts.

image.alt: Six polka dot felt chicken ornaments in green, blue, dark green, orange, grey and black

seoDescription: Felt Ornaments handmade in Nepal by women artisans. Browse the range and send an enquiry for retail or wholesale.

title: Animals and Figures

children.text: Sample text, to be replaced in the Studio. Free-standing felt animals and figures are built up from wool around a firm shape, with fleece, yarn and small felted details added by hand. They stand on a shelf or a table without a hanger, and each one has a slightly different expression from the last. This introduction will describe the animals and seasonal figures made in the workshop, the colours they come in, and how gift shops can ask about mixed orders of handmade felt animals from Nepal.

image.alt: Five curly wool felt sheep in cream, green, multicolour, pink and turquoise on a grey mat

seoDescription: Felt Animals and Figures handmade in Nepal by women artisans. Browse the range and send an enquiry for retail or wholesale.

title: Keyrings

children.text: Sample text, to be replaced in the Studio. A felt key ring is small enough to be a first purchase and sturdy enough to be handled every day. Each animal starts as a firm felted body, then gets its yarn coat and stitched saddle before being fixed to a metal ring by hand. Because they are quick to pack and easy to carry, they are a natural gift. This introduction will list the shapes available, how they are fastened, and how shops can ask about mixed batches of felt key chains.

image.alt: Six felt yak key rings with stitched saddles in black, multicolour, cream, pink, brown and grey

seoDescription: Felt Keyrings handmade in Nepal by women artisans. Browse the range and send an enquiry for retail or wholesale.

title: Hotpot

children.text: Sample text, to be replaced in the Studio. Thick wool felt is a natural insulator, and that is what makes it useful under hot cookware in the kitchen and at the table. These mats are made from hand-rolled felt balls, each one stitched to its neighbours until the mat holds together firmly and sits flat. This introduction will explain the shapes and diameters available, the sizes of pot each mat suits, how to clean them, and how to enquire about colour mixes or a larger order.

image.alt: Round hotpot mat of hand-rolled felt balls in natural white, grey and brown

seoDescription: Felt Hotpot Mats handmade in Nepal by women artisans. Browse the range and send an enquiry for retail or wholesale.

title: Tea Coaster

children.text: Sample text, to be replaced in the Studio. Tea coasters are among the simplest pieces to make well and the easiest way to bring handmade felt into a home. Felt is naturally absorbent and protects a table from the heat of a cup. Small felt balls are rolled by hand and stitched together into a neat, flat square. This introduction will explain the shapes and colours on offer, whether sets can be mixed, and how cafes, hotels and gift shops can ask about wholesale felt tea coasters.

image.alt: Square tea coaster of small felt balls in natural brown and cream, held in one hand

seoDescription: Felt Tea Coasters handmade in Nepal by women artisans. Browse the range and send an enquiry for retail or wholesale.

title: Purse

children.text: Sample text, to be replaced in the Studio. Felt suits a purse because it holds its shape without a stiff lining and keeps its soft surface through years of being carried. Wool is laid out in thin layers, wetted with warm soapy water and worked by hand until the fibres lock together into dense cloth. A purse begins as a flat layered piece worked around a shape, so the body can come out with few seams. This page will introduce the purses made in the workshop, the sizes available, and what to ask about when ordering one piece or placing a wholesale enquiry from Nepal or abroad.

seoDescription: Felt Purses handmade in Nepal by women artisans. Browse the range and send an enquiry for retail or wholesale.

title: Bags

children.text: Sample text, to be replaced in the Studio. A felt bag is light for its size, soft against the body and strong enough for daily use when the wool has been worked densely. Wool is laid out in thin layers, wetted with warm soapy water and worked by hand until the fibres lock together into dense cloth. Larger pieces take longer to full evenly, and straps and handles are attached by hand once the body has dried. This introduction will describe the bag styles on offer, how much each one holds, the colours available, and how shops can ask about wholesale felt bags from Nepal.

seoDescription: Felt Bags handmade in Nepal by women artisans. Browse the range and send an enquiry for retail or wholesale.

title: Hats

children.text: Sample text, to be replaced in the Studio. A felt hat is shaped from a single seamless piece, which is what makes the material so well suited to headwear. Wool is laid out in thin layers, wetted with warm soapy water and worked by hand until the fibres lock together into dense cloth. The damp felt is then pulled over a form and left to dry until it keeps the curve of the crown. This introduction will explain the hat styles on offer, how sizes are measured, and how to enquire about colours or a batch order. Replace it with details from the people who make them.

seoDescription: Felt Hats handmade in Nepal by women artisans. Browse the range and send an enquiry for retail or wholesale.

title: Privacy Policy
seoDescription: How Bishnu Laxmi Felt Handicraft handles the details you send through this website, by email or WhatsApp.

children.text: This policy explains what information Bishnu Laxmi Felt Handicraft ("we", "us") receives through felthandicraftnepal.com, how we use it, and the choices you have. If you have any question about it, email us at felthandicraftnepal@gmail.com.
Information you send us
When you send an enquiry using a form on this website, we receive:
your full name and email address
your phone number, if you choose to give it
the product and size you asked about, if you enquired about a product
anything you write in your message

When you choose to contact us on WhatsApp, the conversation takes place in WhatsApp. We then see your WhatsApp number, your profile name and the messages you send. WhatsApp's own terms and privacy policy apply to its service.
How we use it

We use your information only to reply to your enquiry, to discuss products, quantities, prices and orders with you, and to keep a record of our correspondence. We do not sell or rent your information, and we do not send you marketing messages unless you ask us to.
Services that help run this website
This website uses a small number of outside services. Each handles some information on our behalf:
Web3Forms delivers the messages you send through our forms to our email inbox.
hCaptcha runs the spam check on our forms. To tell people from automated programs, it collects information about your device and how you interact with the check, under hCaptcha's own privacy policy.
Cloudflare hosts the website. Like any web host, it processes technical details such as your IP address and browser type to deliver pages and protect the site from attacks.
Sanity stores the website's content and delivers its product photographs, so your browser requests images from Sanity's servers.
Our inbox is provided by Google Gmail, so enquiries are stored there.
Cookies and tracking

This website does not use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies, and it does not set cookies of its own. hCaptcha may store information in your browser when you use one of our forms, and Cloudflare may set a cookie needed to keep the website secure.
How long we keep it
We keep enquiry emails and messages for as long as we need them to deal with your enquiry and any order that follows, and for our ordinary business records. You can ask us to delete them at any time.
Your choices
You can ask for a copy of the information you have sent us, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Email felthandicraftnepal@gmail.com and we will reply as soon as we can.
Children
This website is not intended for children, and we do not knowingly collect information from them.
Changes to this policy
If we change this policy, we will update it on this page and change the date at the top.

title: Terms and Conditions
seoDescription: The terms for using the Bishnu Laxmi Felt Handicraft website and for enquiring about our handmade felt products.

children.text: These terms apply to your use of felthandicraftnepal.com, the website of Bishnu Laxmi Felt Handicraft, a handmade felt business in Nepal. By using the website, you agree to them. If you do not agree, please do not use the website.
Our products

Every product is made by hand. We describe and photograph our products as accurately as we can, but colours, sizes and details can vary a little from piece to piece and from the photographs, and screens show colours differently. Please ask us if a particular detail matters to you.
Enquiries, prices and orders
This website does not sell products or take payments. It shows our products so that you can enquire about them by WhatsApp or email.
Prices are not shown on the website. They depend on the product, the quantity and any custom work, and we agree them with you directly.
Sending an enquiry does not place an order and does not commit you or us to anything.
An order exists only once we have both agreed its details in writing, for example by email or WhatsApp, including the products, quantities, price, payment and delivery.
Wholesale and custom orders may have their own terms, which we agree with you for each order.
Photographs and content

The text, product photographs, designs and logo on this website belong to Bishnu Laxmi Felt Handicraft or are used with permission. Some photographs are used under licence and are credited where they appear. Please do not copy or reuse any of this material for commercial purposes without our written permission.
Using the website
Please use our forms only to send genuine enquiries. Do not send spam, attempt to interfere with the website, or use it for anything unlawful.
Other services

The website links to WhatsApp and uses outside services such as Web3Forms and hCaptcha to handle enquiries. Their own terms and policies apply when you use them, and we are not responsible for how they operate.
Availability and responsibility

We work to keep the website accurate and available, but we cannot promise that it will always be free of errors or interruptions. As far as the law allows, we are not responsible for any loss that results from using the website. Nothing in these terms limits any right you have that cannot be limited by law.
Law
These terms are governed by the laws of Nepal.
Changes and contact
We may update these terms from time to time. The current version is always on this page, with the date it was last changed. If you have any question, email us at felthandicraftnepal@gmail.com.
